stories.title: Former police officer turned Flintshire MS opposes handing control of policing to Welsh Government
stories.summary: A Flintshire based politician who served with North Wales Police has rejected the case for handing control of policing to the Welsh Government, after the region’s police and crime commissioner cautiously backed the idea. stories.title: Shotton shop building to gain four flats after council approval
stories.summary: Four one-bedroom flats have been approved at a shop building on Chester Road West in Shotton, next door to the Grade II listed Clwyd. stories.title: The TikTok approach parents in Flintshire are being told to warn their children about
stories.summary: Parents across Flintshire are being warned about a scam in which children are approached on TikTok, persuaded to send a photograph, and then blackmailed with a fake explicit image made from it using artificial intelligence. stories.title: Senedd Members support calls for better paternity leave in UK-wide parent strike
stories.summary: Parents and politicians joined together on the steps of the Senedd on Thursday calling for better paternity leave and support for new parents. stories.title: Welsh Government figures show rising proportion of north Wales residents using NHS dentists in England
stories.summary: Nearly one in eleven adults in north Wales who saw an NHS dentist in the two years to March 2026 was treated in England.
